newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Titan 96/97 1st half net lower.
newsitem.headline: India's Titan 96/97 1st half net lower.

text.p: Watchmaker Titan Industries Ltd said on Monday its net profit fell to 63.4 million rupees in the six months to September 30, 1996, from 72 million a year ago.
Net sales for the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) totalled 1,716.9 million rupees from 1,401.5 million in the corresponding period last year, the firm said in a statement.

To partly finance its ongoing capital expenditure programme and increased working capital requirements, Titan said its board proposed a rights issue in the ratio 1:4 at a premium of 50 rupees a share.
